push_token.description: Push notification token. Send again whenever it rotates.

device.description: Captured for fraud checks and push notifications. Send it here, or later via POST /api/users/me/device.

id_token.description: The ID token returned by Google Sign-In.

phone.description: E.164 format, digits with an optional leading +.

notifications_enabled.description: Master switch for push on this account.

quiet_hours.description: Hold marketing back overnight. On by default.

destination_details.description: Payout account details. Encrypted before it is stored.

selected_option.description: Must be one of the quiz options.

category.description: Free text. The app picks it from a list it hard-codes, so options change without a release.

issue_type.description: Free text, same as category. The app hard-codes the options.

occurred_at.description: When the problem happened, from the "When did the issue happen?" picker.

affected_area.description: Where in the app it happened. Optional on the form.

description.example: I completed the offer yesterday but got no coins.

type.description: Immutable key the app sends and reads. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.

value.description: Stored value the client sends back.

question.example: How can I withdraw my earnings?

reason.example: Face does not match the document on file.
reason.description: Shown to the user on a rejection. A default is used when omitted.

category.description: What the message is about. Users who muted this category drop out of the audience; transaction and system are never mutable.

respect_quiet_hours.description: Leave out anyone whose local time is inside the platform quiet hours. Ignored for transaction and system.

body.example: Finish one offer today and collect a bonus.

cz_user_ids.description: Up to 10 users to try it on.

respect_quiet_hours.description: Leave out anyone whose local time is inside the platform quiet hours. Ignored for transaction and system.

body.example: Finish one offer today and collect a bonus.

send_now.description: Default true. Pass false to save a draft, or set scheduled_at to queue it.

reward_gems.description: Gems paid on this day. 0 for none.

label.description: What the app prints on the tile.

is_milestone.description: Drawn with the gold border on the board.

cron.description: A standard 5- or 6-field cron expression, evaluated in UTC.

action.description: Where the tile sends the app.

probability_weight.description: Relative weight, not a percentage. The odds are normalised.

reward_coins_max.description: Upper end of the payout range. Omit to always pay the exact amount.

reward_gems_max.description: Upper end of the gem range.

min_medal_rarity.description: Only users whose best medal reaches this tier can win it. Omit for everyone.

question.example: What is the name of the toy cowboy in Toy Story?

correct_option.description: Must be one of the options.

date.description: The day to copy this quiz onto.

headline_prize_coins.description: The "5,000 Coins" line on the card.

probability_weight.description: Instant games only. A draw ranks its prizes instead.

min_participants.description: Inclusive participant floor for this band.

external_transaction_id.description: Field carrying the partner's transaction id.

milestone_name.description: Field carrying which milestone/goal was just completed, for multi-step offers.

approved_value.description: Value of the status field that means approved.

reversed_value.description: Value of the status field that means reversed.

slug.description: URL-safe, unique. Used in the postback path.

description.example: General offers wall, strong on surveys.

click_url_template.description: Opened in the app iframe. {USER_ID} is replaced with cz_user_id.

postback_secret.description: Path token or HMAC key. Auto-generated when omitted.

coins_per_payout_unit.description: Coins credited per 1 unit of the payout the partner sends.

revenue_share_percent.description: Percent of the payout field passed to the user, when the partner sends raw dollars with no rev-share applied. Omit when the payout field is already the final amount.

rank.description: Higher shows first in the app offerwall list.

threshold.description: Only used by `offers_completed` — offers the friend must finish. Forced to 1 on other triggers.

setting_value.description: Always a string. The catalogue decides how it is parsed — "12", "0.025" or "true".
